translations.EN: We are not there yet.
translations.TL: Hindi pa tayo dumarating sa puntong iyan.

translations.EN: Slow down. We need more time before that.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Kailangan pa natin ng panahon bago 'yan.

translations.EN: Let us take things one step at a time.
translations.TL: Isa-isa lang nating harapin ang mga bagay.

translations.EN: Trust takes time out here. We are not there yet.
translations.TL: Ang tiwala ay pinaghihirapan dito. Hindi pa tayo nandoon.

translations.EN: We are still figuring each other out.
translations.TL: Kinikilala pa natin ang isa't isa.

translations.EN: Hold on. That is moving faster than I am ready for.
translations.TL: Teka muna. Mas mabilis 'yan kaysa sa kaya ko ngayon.

translations.EN: Let us build some history first.
translations.TL: Bumuo muna tayo ng tiwala at pinagsamahan.

translations.EN: I need to know you better before we go there.
translations.TL: Kailangan muna kitang makilala pa bago pumunta roon.

translations.EN: Not yet. Let us keep our feet on the ground.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ngayon. Manatili muna tayong nakatuntong sa lupa.

translations.EN: We are allies right now. Let us leave it at that.
translations.TL: Magkakampi tayo sa ngayon. Manatili muna tayo roon.

translations.EN: That is a little too familiar for us.
translations.TL: Masyado nang pamilyar 'yan para sa atin.

translations.EN: You are getting ahead of where we stand.
translations.TL: Nauuna ka sa kung ano lang ang ugnayan natin.

translations.EN: Let us keep a professional distance for now.
translations.TL: Panatilihin muna natin ang maayos na distansya.

translations.EN: We have not earned that kind of closeness yet.
translations.TL: Hindi pa natin nararating ang ganyang kalapit na samahan.

translations.EN: Pull back a step. That is too close for comfort.
translations.TL: Umatras ka nang kaunti. Masyadong malapit 'yan.

translations.EN: I like you, but do not push the boundaries.
translations.TL: Mabuti ang tingin ko sa 'yo, pero huwag mong tawirin ang hangganan.

translations.EN: That feels a bit presumptuous.
translations.TL: Medyo mapangahas ang dating niyan.

translations.EN: Let us not pretend we are closer than we actually are.
translations.TL: Huwag nating ipagpanggap na mas malapit tayo kaysa sa totoo.

translations.EN: Boundary check. Step it back.
translations.TL: Bantayan ang hangganan. Umatras ka nang kaunti.

translations.EN: We have boundaries. Respect them.
translations.TL: May mga hangganan tayo. Igalang mo ang mga 'yon.
